A single-cell layout wrapper preserves its nested data table as structured Markdown

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"br_in_tables":true,"compact_tables":true}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
